answer: The best CZ pair on garnet is QB12-QB17. Its IRB CZ fidelity is 0.99878, with an uncertainty of 0.00037. This comes from the default calibration set edea61a8-0087-446a-836a-66ff46ee5413. QB12-QB7 is a very close second at 0.99878. I ran a Bell circuit on exactly QB12 and QB17 on garnet:mock with 100 shots. I wrote it as native gates (prx, cz, prx) and measured both qubits, so the transpiler did not pick other qubits. The job completed with counts 00: 57 and 11: 43, in the order QB12 then QB17. Only the mock was used, so no credits were spent.
